name: Super Mario 64 Co-op Deluxe
subtitle: Super Mario 64 Co-op Deluxe for Apple Vision Pro
localizedDescription: Super Mario 64 Co-op Deluxe on Apple Vision Pro: the full game rendered natively on Metal, online co-op over CoopNet, and a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode with live-tunable screen size, distance, depth, and focus. Ships with no game content; you supply your own Super Mario 64 (US) ROM.
